title: The relief column

branches.consequence: A Raid finds the Sorenne patrol if the authorised, funded Navigation order is Relief and its voyage actually crosses. Grey Petrel Relief lift counts. At opening Readiness 2+, Raid costs Stability −2 total and achieves combat; at 0–1, Spear is disabled, Raid costs Stability −1 and provides no qualifying combat.

The Raid finds no target, costs Stability −1, leaves Spear intact and provides no qualifying combat. A proposed, unfunded or halted Relief order does not qualify. Shared, Military and private Trade do not qualify.
Relief alone does not cause an attack or a Raid penalty. These effects require an actual Raid assignment or funded council Raid.

public_rules: Combat changes Readiness by +1 once; no successful combat changes it by −1 once. Ordinary cargo, Guard, duty breaches and consumption still apply. A council Raid needs offered Spear; an independent Raid uses its own assignment.
use: Compare Raid with restraint or protection. Relief can enable a Raid, but does not force the army to make one; foresight cannot reveal its future choice.
